name: lease_recognition_leverage_covenant_repayment
question_template: A company reports shareholders' equity E={EQUITY} USD and interest-bearing debt D={DEBT} USD immediately before recognising a new lease on its balance sheet. The lease requires n={LEASE_TERM} annual payments of L={LEASE_PAYMENT} USD, each paid at the {TIMING} of the year, and the company discounts them at its incremental borrowing rate r={RATE} percent, compounded annually. At recognition the lease liability equals the present value of the payments and the right-of-use asset is recognised at exactly the same amount, so equity is unchanged; the lease liability counts as interest-bearing debt. A loan covenant requires interest-bearing debt divided by equity to be at most m={COVENANT_MAX}. If the ratio after recognition exceeds m, the company immediately repays existing debt from surplus cash (equity unchanged; assume sufficient cash) by the minimum amount that brings the ratio to exactly m; if the ratio is at or below m, no repayment is made. Use exact arithmetic. Compute the required debt repayment in USD (0 if none).

slots.description: Present value of the lease payments in USD.
Interest-bearing debt over equity after the lease.
Whether post-lease leverage exceeds the covenant maximum.
Largest debt consistent with the covenant in USD.

program:
def solve():
    E0 = Q(P["EQUITY"])
    D0 = Q(P["DEBT"])
    L = Q(P["LEASE_PAYMENT"])
    n = P["LEASE_TERM"]
    r = Q(P["RATE"]) / 100
    m = Q(P["COVENANT_MAX"])
    timing = P["TIMING"]
    if r <= 0:
        raise ValueError("rate must be positive")
    v = 1 / (1 + r)
    annuity = (1 - v ** n) / r
    if timing == "start":
        annuity = annuity * (1 + r)
    pv = L * annuity
    debt_after = D0 + pv
    ratio = debt_after / E0
    max_debt = m * E0
    breached = ratio > m
    if breached:
        repay = debt_after - max_debt
    else:
        repay = Q(0)
    return {
        "final": repay,
        "lease_liability_recognised": pv,
        "leverage_after_recognition": ratio,
        "covenant_breached": "true" if breached else "false",
        "maximum_permitted_debt": max_debt,
    }
